insights.summary: At an investor meet on 3 September 2026 STL announced 'Lakshya': ₹20,000 Cr of revenue by FY29 (over 4x FY26) and an EBITDA margin above 27%. To get there it plans about ₹1,000 Cr of capex a year for three years, expanding preform, fibre and cable capacity by 50% and building a new optical connectivity plant in India. Management pointed to AI data centres (fibre per rack rising 64x over GPU generations), an order book above $2 billion and Q1's record results.

what_changed.text: FY29 target: ₹20,000 Cr revenue and 27%+ EBITDA margin
Capex raised to about ₹1,000 Cr a year for three years (was ₹500 Cr)
In-house work on co-packaged and near-packaged optics

tone.label: confident
tone.quote: Today, we are very proud to announce Lakshya, STL’s growth ambition for FY29.

red_flags.text: The FY29 target needs revenue to grow more than 4x in three years.
₹3,000 Cr of capex over three years after years of losses; returns depend on the data-centre cycle.

watch_next: FY27 and FY28 revenue on the path to ₹20,000 Cr
